dg_doc_areas.assumption: APPROXIMATION: One declared cargo hold per 40ft bay pair with its two hatch pontoons. Forward hold has reduced authorization excluding flammable liquids, water-reactive, self-heating and oxidizing classes. All holds exclude explosives, flammable/toxic gases, organic peroxides, infectious and radioactive cargo. These are synthetic choices, not typical certified feeder facts.
dg_doc_areas.equipment_assumptions: Synthetic water supply, smoke detection, fixed fire extinguishing, protected electrical equipment, suitable separate bilge drainage, PPE and six empty-hold air changes per hour with appropriate upper/lower non-sparking extraction. No class 2.1/2.3 service. SOLAS II-2/19.3 design premise only; no approval claimed.

APPROXIMATION: Synthetic SOLAS II-2/19 DoC-style space authorization, not a certificate or automatic shipment clearance. SOLAS Table 19.3 specifies equipment by cargo/form, not permission alone. Exclusion of classes 6.2/7 is operating policy, not a claim that SOLAS bans them. Physical packing forms and all subsidiary risks must be independently checked. Per-hold grouping is not evidence of an IMDG segregation bulkhead.
